title: Suffix lookups in a paired encoding
statement: For any finite bit strings $\alpha$ and $x$ and any natural number $j$, the optional bit at index $2|\alpha|+2+j$ in the encoding formed by doubling each bit of $\alpha$, appending $01$, and then appending $x$ equals the optional bit at index $j$ in $x$.
replaced:
For all bit strings $\alpha$ and $x$ and every natural number $j$, the
optional cell lookup at index $2\abs{\alpha}+2+j$ in the self-delimiting
pairing $\langle \alpha, x\rangle$ agrees with the optional lookup at index
$j$ in $x$; both are simultaneously undefined when $j \ge \abs{x}$.
